question: Who became the first Indian to win a gold medal in the World Athletics Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Neeraj Chopra** became the first Indian to win a gold medal at the **World Athletics Championships** in **2023**.
 
• He won the gold medal in the **men's javelin throw** event with a throw of **88.17 meters**.
